SELECT a.usr_id AS userId, /* 사용자 ID */ a.usr_nm AS userNm, /* 사용자 명 */ a.ognz_cd AS ognzCd, /* 조직 코드 */ b.ognz_nm AS ognzNm, /* 조직 명 */ a.auth_cd AS authrtCd, /* 권한 코드 */ (SELECT s.auth_nm FROM cdm_own.auth s WHERE s.auth_cd = a.auth_cd ) AS authrtCdNm, /* 권한 코드 명 */ a.usr_tpcd AS userTypeCd, /* 사용자 유형 코드 */ (SELECT s.cmmn_cd_nm FROM cdm_own.cmmn_cd s WHERE s.cd_grop_cd = 'USER_TYPE_CD' AND s.cmmn_cd = a.usr_tpcd AND s.lcal_cd = 'ko') AS userTypeCdNm, /* 사용자 유형 코드 명 */ a.mbl_tel_no AS mblTelNo, /* 휴대 전화 번호 */ a.eml_addr AS emlAddr, /* 이메일 주소 */ a.usr_phto AS userPhoto, /* 사용자 사진 */ a.use_yn AS useYn /* 사용 여부 */ FROM cdm_own.usr a LEFT JOIN cdm_own.ognz b ON a.ognz_cd = b.ognz_cd WHERE 1=1
AND (a.usr_id like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or a.usr_nm like '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND a.ognz_cd in ()
AND a.usr_id = #{userId}
AND a.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY a.usr_nm, a.usr_id

SELECT a.ognz_cd AS ognzCd, /* 조직 코드 */ a.ognz_nm AS ognzNm, /* 조직 명 */ a.ognz_lvl AS ognzLvl, /* 조직 레벨 */ a.anct_ognz_cd AS upOgnzCd, /* 상위 조직 코드 */ a.sort_seq AS sortSn, /* 정렬 일련번호 */ a.use_yn AS useYn /* 사용 여부 */ FROM cdm_own.ognz a WHERE 1=1
AND (a.ognz_cd like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or a.ognz_nm like '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND a.ognz_cd in ()
AND a.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY a.ognz_lvl, a.sort_seq, a.ognz_cd

SELECT c.cd AS value, /* 코드 */ c.cd_nm AS name, /* 코드명 */ c.cd_group AS cdGroup, /* 코드그룹 */ c.sort_sn AS sortSn /* 정렬 순번 */ FROM cdm_own.cmpt_cmpy_cd c WHERE c.cmpy_type_cd = #{cmpyTypeCd} AND c.cd_group = #{cdGroup} AND c.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY c.sort_sn ASC, c.cd ASC
select prgrm.prgrm_id from cdm_own.prgrm prgrm inner join cdm_own.prgrm_auth prgrm_authrt on prgrm.prgrm_id = prgrm_authrt.prgrm_id where prgrm_authrt.auth_cd = #{authrtCd}
select prgrm.prgrm_id from cdm_own.prgrm prgrm where prgrm.http_mthd_nm = 'common'

select prgrm.prgrm_id from cdm_own.prgrm prgrm inner join cdm_own.usr_prgrm_auth prgrm_authrt on prgrm.prgrm_id = prgrm_authrt.prgrm_id where prgrm_authrt.usr_id = #{userId} and prgrm_authrt.auth_grnt_dvcd = '01' /* 권한이 부여된 */

select prgrm.prgrm_id from cdm_own.prgrm prgrm inner join cdm_own.usr_prgrm_auth prgrm_authrt on prgrm.prgrm_id = prgrm_authrt.prgrm_id where prgrm_authrt.usr_id = #{userId} and prgrm_authrt.auth_grnt_dvcd = '02' /* 권한이 제거된 */

SELECT TO_CHAR(A.current_time, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS currentDatetime, TO_CHAR(A.current_time, 'YYYYMMDD') AS currentDate, TO_CHAR(A.current_time, 'HH24MISS') AS currentTime, A.current_time AS currentTimestamp, TO_CHAR(A.current_time, 'YYYY') AS currentYear, TO_CHAR(A.current_time, 'MM') AS currentMonth, TO_CHAR(A.current_time, 'DD') AS currentDay, TO_CHAR(A.current_time, 'HH24') AS currentHour, TO_CHAR(A.current_time, 'MI') AS currentMinute FROM (SELECT NOW() AS current_time ) AS A

WITH RECURSIVE menu_tree AS ( SELECT menu.menu_id, menu.menu_nm, menu.anct_menu_id AS up_menu_id, menu.npag_yn, menu.url_addr, LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(menu.sort_seq, 0) AS VARCHAR),3,'0') as sort_path, menu.menu_use_yn, menu.scrn_size, 1 AS level from cdm_own.menu menu inner join cdm_own.menu_auth authrt on menu.menu_id = authrt.menu_id WHERE (menu.anct_menu_id IS null or menu.anct_menu_id ='') and authrt.auth_cd = #{authrtCd} UNION ALL SELECT menu.menu_id, menu.menu_nm, menu.anct_menu_id AS up_menu_id, menu.npag_yn, menu.url_addr, mt.sort_path || '-' || LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(menu.sort_seq, 1) AS VARCHAR),3,'0') as sort_path, menu.menu_use_yn, menu.scrn_size, mt.level + 1 AS level FROM cdm_own.menu menu inner join cdm_own.menu_auth authrt on menu.menu_id = authrt.menu_id inner join menu_tree mt ON menu.anct_menu_id = mt.menu_id WHERE authrt.auth_cd = #{authrtCd} ) SELECT menu_nm, menu_id, menu.npag_yn, menu.url_addr, COALESCE(up_menu_id, '') as up_menu_id, sort_path, menu.menu_use_yn, menu.scrn_size, level FROM menu_tree menu WHERE COALESCE(menu.menu_use_yn, 'Y') != 'N' order by sort_path

SELECT menu.MENU_ID, menu.MENU_NM, menu.NPAG_YN, menu.ANCT_MENU_ID AS UP_MENU_ID, menu.URL_ADDR, menu.SORT_SEQ AS SORT_SN FROM cdm_own.MENU menu inner join cdm_own.usr_menu_auth menu_authrt on menu.menu_id = menu_authrt.menu_id where menu_authrt.usr_id = #{userId} AND COALESCE(menu.menu_use_yn, 'Y') != 'N' and menu_authrt.auth_grnt_dvcd = '01' /* 권한이 부여된 */

select menu.menu_id from cdm_own.menu menu inner join cdm_own.usr_menu_auth menu_authrt on menu.menu_id = menu_authrt.menu_id where menu_authrt.usr_id = #{userId} AND COALESCE(menu.menu_use_yn, 'Y') != 'N' and menu_authrt.auth_grnt_dvcd = '02' /* 권한이 제거된 */

SELECT COALESCE(sum(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_cntn_idnty_dt))),0) AS seconds_difference FROM cdm_own.cmpt_user_lgn_hstry WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND lgn_ymd = TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
mapper.update: UPDATE cdm_own.cmpt_user_lgn_hstry SET last_cntn_idnty_dt = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND lgn_ymd = TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')

with recursive sub_orgs as (
select ognz_cd from cdm_own.view_ognz where ognz_cd = #{ognzCd} and use_yn = 'Y' union all
select v.ognz_cd from cdm_own.view_ognz v join sub_orgs s on v.up_ognz_cd = s.ognz_cd where use_yn = 'Y' ) select ognz_cd from sub_orgs

select usr_id from cdm_own.usr usr inner join ( with recursive sub_orgs as ( select ognz_cd from cdm_own.view_ognz where ognz_cd = #{ognzCd} and use_yn = 'Y' union all select v.ognz_cd from cdm_own.view_ognz v join sub_orgs s on v.up_ognz_cd = s.ognz_cd where use_yn = 'Y' ) select ognz_cd from sub_orgs ) ognz on usr.ognz_cd = ognz.ognz_cd

SELECT a.cmpy_id AS value , a.cmpy_nm AS name , b.cmmn_cd_nm AS sub FROM cdm_own.cmpt_cmpy_inf a left join cdm_own.cmmn_cd b on a.cmpy_type_cd = b.cmmn_cd and b.cd_grop_cd = 'CMPY_TYPE_CD' and b.lcal_cd = 'ko' WHERE a.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY a.cmpy_reg_dt
SELECT auth_cd AS value , auth_nm AS name FROM cdm_own.auth WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_seq
